content.rationale: S5-undo (qkqkuzxw) and G-select-undo (wwrrqtox) fix which operation undo names — the marker before the position — and S5-redo (yvtmrnsr) with G-select-redo (qtysmzxy) the marker at it; S5-undo-effect (zuqzrlrx) and S5-redo-effect (xovuxpvq) fix the whole state each leaves. S5-ordered (kupzywsq) and G-order (ukulkqqw) fix that the position splits the applied prefix from the undo tail, D15b and the linear history (qwqwqtuq, kpptprql) that redo is valid exactly while the position is before the list, and S5-count-bounds (ltrmwytx) that a position past the markers is not a valid state; S5-empty-undo (twmzwwll) and S5-empty-redo (tomomvzw) name the two empty cases. M-layout (szmuyqrq) places the module flat at src/markers_guards.rs. It names the state through M-markers' closed types and its refusals through M-refusal's value. Two cursor transitions over the state alone: undo answers with the position one further back and the marker at pos-1 — its kind, target, kept entry ids and the place to record the reverts — named for the verb to take the inverse the kind names; redo answers with the marker at pos — the reverts recorded against it named for the verb — cleared and the position one forward. The marker list stands under both. The position is checked where a reader of the file can act on it. The module reads no file, stores nothing, and reverts nothing: the answer is the state the invocation persists, and a state that cannot answer is a refusal naming its cause, never rendered here.
